title: Machine Learning Model for Predicting Mortality Risk in Patients With Complex Chronic Conditions: Retrospective Analysis.
summary: Machine-learning survival models predicted mortality in patients with complex chronic conditions and identified risk patterns in retrospective records; results are population- and data-source-bound.
ai_technology: XGBoost and gradient-boosting survival models use clinical and healthcare-resource variables to estimate mortality in patients with complex chronic conditions.
organization: Research Group on Innovation; Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol Institut Català de la Salut Badalona Spain

evidence.tested: In a retrospective cohort, XGBoost achieved AUC 0.88 for four-year mortality prediction; prediction of early mortality was weaker, with recall 0.55.
evidence.unknown: Results are bounded to the analyzed population and records; prospective care impact is untested.
evidence.ai_role: XGBoost and gradient-boosting survival models use clinical and healthcare-resource variables to estimate mortality in patients with complex chronic conditions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
